stem.text: What correctly describes the effect of carcinogens on lung tissue that causes a tumour to develop?

A.text: Cells in damaged alveoli walls divide more rapidly to replace damaged areas.

B.text: Cilia are paralysed and mucus accumulates in the lungs causing DNA to change.

C.text: DNA changes, causing bronchial epithelial cells to divide by mitosis in an uncontrolled way.

D.text: Haemoglobin carries less oxygen, causing bronchial cells to divide by mitosis in an uncontrolled way.
